description: Search the Single Onshore Borehole Index (SOBI) — over 1 million UK borehole, shaft, and well site-investigation records — near a point. Returns reference number, site name, grid reference, depth, and a scan URL where available. Data: British Geological Survey (ogcapi.bgs.ac.uk), Open Government Licence, no auth required.

lat.description: Decimal degree latitude (WGS84) — must be supplied together with lng. Omit both for full Great Britain coverage.

limit.description: Maximum borehole records to return (default 20, max 100)

lng.description: Decimal degree longitude (WGS84) — must be supplied together with lat.

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometres around lat/lng (default 5, max 50)

name: bgs-ogcapi.geology.borehole_search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: BGS Borehole Index Search
